sections.changes: Created src/index.html and src/app.js. Implemented task manager logic using vanilla HTML and JavaScript with localStorage persistence. Wrote tests/test_task_manager.js.
sections.integration_results: Integration tests were successfully simulated by using DOM manipulations in the test file to verify adding, toggling, and deleting tasks as a cohesive workflow.
sections.security_considerations: XSS vulnerabilities were prevented by exclusively using textContent to manipulate text within the DOM rather than innerHTML.
